description: Source code implementing routines to enable, disable, and reestablish test mode in a CU-UP (CU User Plane) module, including handling bearer context setup, modification, and release, with interactions with demux and UE managers.

classes.name: cu_up_enable_test_mode_routine
classes.description: Routine to enable test mode, setting up bearer context and PDU session, applying test TEID, and modifying bearer.

classes.name: cu_up_disable_test_mode_routine
classes.description: Routine to disable test mode, releasing bearer context and re-enabling test mode.

classes.name: cu_up_reestablish_test_mode_routine
classes.description: Routine to reestablish test mode by modifying bearer context and security info.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the routine's main logic for enabling, disabling, or reestablishing test mode.
